title: Update requirements map and strategy view to current state
summary: Add four addenda rows (AD-12 to AD-15) to the requirements map, re-assess every row against landed work with a cited commit or file for each status change, recount the strategy view's coverage table (124 rows become 128), and rewrite "What to do next" as an ordered list with blockers. Docs only.

defaults_applied.how: Each status change cites a commit or file; the map still says no command measured coverage.
Plain cell text that an outside reader can follow.
One focused docs change, limited to the map and the strategy view plus the changelog.
Row IDs, counts and statuses were recovered from the existing tables, not asked about.
The coverage table is recounted from the tables themselves, not patched by adding to old numbers.
BRIEF.md asks for tagged releases and a changelog, so the change records itself in CHANGELOG.md.

assumptions: The new rows are numbered AD-12 to AD-15 in addendum order, giving 128 rows in total, up from 124.
Commit hashes come from git log of the working repository; the reader could not see history, so the producer must look them up.
Row statuses are judged by reading the cited files, not by running commands, consistent with the map's existing method.
roadmap.md is touched only if the new 'What to do next' contradicts it; the request names only two files.
CHANGELOG.md is listed because this repository's change reading lists it as a deliverable by default.

acceptance_criteria.text: requirements-map.md has four new rows in the Addenda table, AD-12 Root causes, AD-13 Introspection on every correction, AD-14 Decision sets and knowing when a decision is not working, AD-15 Common sense over rigid rules, each citing the correct BRIEF.md line range (BRIEF.md:498-513) and evidence files.

Every row whose status changed from the current map (for example AD-4, AD-5, A5-5, A6-4, A2-4, A1-1, A8-1, AD-10, AD-11, A4-2, JG-5) shows the new status and cites a commit hash (checked with git log) or a file that justifies it; rows with unchanged status are left as they are or re-confirmed.

Evidence cells still cite BRIEF by line and other files by heading or quote, per the map's 'How to cite' rules, and the map's intro, statuses and wording sections remain accurate (for example the claim that no command measured coverage).

strategy-view.md per-goal Covered/Partial/Not covered lists match the map's statuses exactly, each ID appears under exactly one goal (the four new rows are assigned to goals), and the coverage table counts per goal and the Total row equal the counts of rows in the map's tables.
strategy-view.md 'What to do next' is an ordered (numbered) list toward the brief, and each step names what blocks it; it is consistent with docs/design/roadmap.md or the roadmap is updated to agree.
CHANGELOG.md Unreleased gets an entry for this documentation update.
Run `git diff --stat` and `git status`: only the listed docs (and CHANGELOG.md) changed; run `cargo test` and `cargo fmt --check` to confirm docs-only changes break no doc-link or boundary tests.

out_of_scope: No code, tests or configuration change.
No new designs; designs not yet built keep their not-covered or partial status.
Rewriting the roadmap beyond keeping it consistent.
departures: Cost and time sit above the reference. About 128 rows must be re-assessed against git history and counts recomputed exactly, which is easy to get wrong, so the pass probability is lower.
